exposure: mode of birth (normal vaginal delivery, LSCS)
finding: Intracranial ventricular dimensions (AHW, VI, TOD) were found to significantly increase with increasing gestational age and birth weight.
mod_finding: All three ventricular parameters (AHW, VI, TOD) had significantly lower mean values in the normal vaginal delivery group compared to the LSCS group.
birth_weight: Measured as a variable across the included newborns.
gest_age: Measured as a variable across the included newborns.
